 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Bryce James is finally playing college basketball in 2026 and he already has a highlight that caught fans' eyes on Tuesday. 
 Bryce James redshirted his freshman year with the Arizona Wildcats in 2025-26. However, as a sophomore, LeBron James' younger son is finally seeing the floor. In their third game of the season, James was on the floor as the Wildcats comfortably beat the Northern Arizona Lumberjacks.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Bryce wasn't exactly statistically dominant, he barely shot the ball and had just three points. James added two assists and two steals to that tally as well. However, the moment from this game which went viral was his only block, and it was one fans had a lot to say about it.
 Basketball fans say Bryce James has all the tools to have a successful career in the game
 James made his college debut against UCLA on November 2, and scored his first points three days later against Cal Poly, finishing with five points, two assists and two steals. His team split those games 1-1, but they now officially have a winning record following this latest win.
 During the second half of the game, Bryce found himself as the last man in the paint. And when one of the Lumberjack players went up to score, James was there to reject it in style.
 "I know it's easy to say, but he looks just like his pops here," one fan wrote. "Ngl I've always thought Bryce was better than Bronny," a second fan claimed. "Bryce and Kiyan gonna be cold, just gotta give them some time," another said.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "Sent that one back to the parking lot. The James family group chat has a new highlight to argue about," a fourth comment read. "That block was absolutely brutal. Pure defensive dominance," a fifth fan commented. "I have seen enough, the Lakers have to get him," a sixth fan posted.
 Bryce is still quite raw as a prospect, and will likely need another year in college before he is ready for the NBA. Even with that, there is no guarantee he will make it to the league. However, with highlights like these and some strong performances, those narratives might just start to change.
